title: 7 best practices for Facebook retargeting ads — WasteNot

facts.fact: The page states that Facebook has over 3 billion users across its portfolio of apps and services.
facts.quote: With over 3 billion users across a portfolio of apps and services

facts.fact: Per the page, Facebook retargeting only allows marketers to retarget users who visited their properties within the last 180 days.
facts.quote: you can only retarget users that have visited your properties within the last 180 days

facts.fact: Per the page, a conversion can only be attributed to a Facebook ad if it occurs within 28 days of ad exposure.
facts.quote: can only attribute a conversion to an ad if it occurs within 28 days of ad exposure

facts.fact: McKinsey & Co., as reported on the page, found that 71% of customers expect personalization.
facts.quote: 71% of customers expect personalization, and 76% of customers actually get frustrated

facts.fact: McKinsey & Co., as reported on the page, found that 76% of customers get frustrated when their experiences with brands aren't personalized.
facts.quote: 76% of customers actually get frustrated when their experiences with brands aren’t personalized

facts.fact: The page states that if the Meta pixel is used to track user activity, it must be included in the website cookie policy under the GDPR.
facts.quote: it must be included in your website cookie policy as per

facts.fact: The page states that the brand does not own data collected by the Meta pixel; Facebook does.
facts.quote: your brand does not own the data collected by the pixel, Facebook does

facts.fact: The page defines first-party data as user data collected from a business's owned properties, such as websites, apps, OTT platforms, and POS kiosks.
facts.quote: First-party data is user data that is collected from your business's owned properties, such as your websites, apps, OTT platforms, and POS kiosks.

facts.fact: The article was published by Joey Colvin on April 7, 2024.
